invariant: Every span in every path family below is finalized exactly once via apply_r3n4_finalize_bundle, which derives identity only from an IdentityAnchorV1 built from raw offsets (never from prior candidate_id, normalized text, or ranker output).

protected.origin: language_analyzer span_annotations flagged protected_reason (PROTECTED_SPAN / UNKNOWN_IDENTIFIER / r3d_protected_hard_gate)

skipped_english.origin: english_identity_guard classify_disposition marks span ENGLISH-eligible and skips transliteration

english_guard_reorder.origin: english_identity_guard reorder-only disposition (REORDER/GUARD reason codes) — candidates reordered but not regenerated

abstention.origin: ranker abstains (ABSTAIN eligibility) — no confident candidate above threshold

acronym.origin: language_analyzer / english_identity_guard acronym disposition (ACRONYM_IDENTITY reason code or IDENTIFIER_OR_CODE form with acronym shape)

structural_identifier.origin: language_analyzer IDENTIFIER_OR_CODE form (letter+digit token, e.g. SKU-44102)

refined_identifier.origin: mai07_r3n4_candidate_runtime.refine_overmerged_identifier_spans — splits a spurious space-containing identifier/protected span (no digit evidence) back into per-token spans before generation

coalesced_identifier.origin: mai07_r3n4_candidate_runtime.coalesce_structural_identifiers — merges abutting fragments into one identifier span when letter+digit+separator evidence exists; a COALESCED_SPAN identity anchor is also created at coalesce time for provenance
coalesced_identifier.identity_source: IdentityAnchorV1 from raw_span offsets (post-coalesce); coalesce_anchor available for anchor-lineage reconstruction

multi_token_phrase.origin: raw_span surface contains multiple whitespace-separated tokens that survived analysis as one annotation (ambiguous/shared phrase spans)

optional_ambiguous.origin: shared/ambiguous disposition (OPTIONAL reason code or is_ambiguous flag) — conservative identity-preferred policy

cap_pressure.origin: generator/ranker produced more than 5 raw alternatives (or span.truncated already set) before finalization
cap_pressure.finalized_via: apply_r3n4_finalize_bundle (identity reserved first, then target Devanagari, then fill by rank, hard-capped at MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_SPAN)

failure_fallback.identity_source: IdentityAnchorV1 from raw_span offsets, or FAIL_CLOSED synthetic anchor when raw offsets are invalid
failure_fallback.finalized_via: apply_r3n4_finalize_bundle (fail-closed branch when create_identity_anchor raises IdentityAnchorError)

empty_generator_result.origin: no candidates produced by generation (NO_CANDIDATES reason code or empty candidate tuple)

ordinary_romanized_generation.origin: default path — normal romanized/Devanagari candidate generation and ranking with no special disposition

anchor_lineage_helpers.create_identity_anchor: raw-slice anchor from (raw_text, raw_start, raw_end_exclusive); validates bounds and digests
anchor_lineage_helpers.refine_anchor: child anchor strictly contained within a parent anchor's span (used by refine_overmerged_identifier_spans lineage)
anchor_lineage_helpers.coalesce_anchor: anchor spanning multiple non-overlapping parent anchors (used by coalesce_structural_identifiers lineage)
anchor_lineage_helpers.split_anchors: ordered non-overlapping child anchors carved out of one parent anchor

fail_closed_policy: If create_identity_anchor raises IdentityAnchorError on the primary raw offsets, apply_r3n4_finalize_bundle falls back to a synthetic single-candidate identity-only anchor built from the existing raw_span.original_text and tags decision_reason_codes with R3N4_FAIL_CLOSED_FINALIZE; the span is still recorded in the path registry (ok=True, reason=fail_closed) so the coverage report distinguishes fail-closed finalizations from anchor_unrecoverable failures.
single_finalization_guarantee: record_path_finalization is invoked exactly once per span_results entry inside apply_r3n4_finalize_bundle; no other code path calls finalize_candidates_r3n4 directly for production candidate output. Unit/property tests may call finalize_candidates_r3n4/finalize_idempotent directly on synthetic anchors for verification only.
note: This inventory documents source-derived routing logic (grep of mai07_r3n4_candidate_runtime.py and r3n4_candidate_finalization.py); per-case empirical path_coverage_report() output is only available once a holdout attempt has been run (out of scope for this infra-adaptation phase).
